purpose: AI-generated conceptual anatomical illustration of EEG, ECG and EMG acquisition regions. Not a placement protocol, patient photograph or measured project result.
reference: User-supplied screenshot of previous electrode placement diagram
prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational.
Asset type: replacement illustration for an academic biosignal research website.
Input image: reference of the existing figure to redesign completely, not a photograph to preserve. Keep its three conceptual modalities EEG, ECG, EMG and their site categories, but replace the toy block-person and dense paragraphs.
Create a polished, realistic anatomical medical-atlas illustration on a pure white background, landscape 1536 x 1024. Restrained scientific editorial style, anatomically natural adult human proportions, softly shaded natural skin tones, fine precise contours, no plastic mannequin, no cinematic lighting, no futuristic glow. Clearly an educational illustration, not a fake clinical photograph.
Composition: one adult male head-and-upper-torso anatomical illustration on the left, turned slightly to make the region behind one ear visible, neutral face, short hair, shoulders and upper arms, no lower-body anatomy. The right half has three evenly spaced close-up anatomical detail panels with fine leader lines, generous white space, elegant readable sans-serif type in dark navy. Show general recording regions with small understated color markers, not a precise wiring/placement protocol. EEG marker blue (#2866a9) behind the external ear on adjacent skin, never in the ear canal. ECG marker rust (#b74930) on the chest region. EMG marker green (#287650) over the upper-arm deltoid region. Closeups show recognizably natural ear-and-adjacent-skin, upper chest, and shoulder/upper arm respectively, with small white adhesive sensor pads and restrained color accents. Do not draw nerves, exposed organs, surgery, arrows depicting electrical stimulation, polarities, electrode distances or detailed wiring.
Only these exact labels, no other text:
Top title: "Biosignal acquisition sites"
First detail: "EEG" and "Behind-ear region" and "Brain activity"
Second detail: "ECG" and "Chest region" and "Cardiac activity"
Third detail: "EMG" and "Upper-arm region" and "Muscle activity"
Small footer: "Conceptual research illustration — not a placement protocol"
No two-minute claim, no caregiver application instructions, no clinical validation claims, no brand logos, no website frame, no stock-photo watermark. Keep all labels legible, no overlapping leader lines. Professional anatomical realism and clear visual teaching, not a stock AI-tech illustration.
